book.name: Sua Turkeŋana
book.title: Sua Turkeŋana Ta Merere Iswe La Ki Yoan

content: Aŋela ta iteege ro lulŋana musaari

To motoŋ ila na, aŋre aŋela toro tau mburaanaŋana kat, imbot saamba mi isu. Imbot lela miiri tieene, mi za imbot kor pa uteene. Ruŋguunu iyaara kembei zoŋ mataana. Mi kumbuunu ru na, kembei ta you miaana.
Mi iteege ro musaari ta tipeele pataaŋa kek. Iur kumbuunu woono isu tai, mi kumbuunu ŋas na ise toono.
To iboobo ma kalŋaana biibi kat kembei ta laion. Mi saamba ikuruŋ pa lamata mi ru be ipekel. Ikuruŋ raama sua.
Ikuruŋ to, nio aŋkam be aŋbeede ka sua. Som, mi kalŋaana imbot saamba mi isu ma iso: “Sua ta saamba ikuruŋ pa ma ima na, kozo beede pepe. Imbot turkeŋana.”
To aŋela ta aŋre i imender se tai mi toono na, isara namaana woono isala pa saamba be ipombol sua kini.
Mi kwoono imbol ma iso: “Ŋonoono kat ta Tomtom Biibi tau imbot mataana yaryaara ma alok i. Ni ta iur saamba mi toono mi tai raama koroŋ boozomen ta timbotmbot pa. Ni ko irao inaama mini na som.

Sombe aŋela ta iwe lamata mi ru pa i, imaŋga be iwi twiiri kini, tona Anutu kola ikam ma uruunu ambaiŋana mi ŋgar kini turkeŋana ta munŋaana men imap ma iur ŋonoono. Ŋgar tana, muŋgu ni iswe la ki mbesooŋo kini ta tisoyaara kalŋaana pizin tomtom na.”
To kalŋaana ta muŋgu aŋleŋ imbot saamba mi isu na, iso mar pio mini. Iso: “La ma kam ro ta tipeele ma imbot se aŋela ta imender se tai mi toono na namaana.”
Tana aŋla kini, mi aŋwi i be ikam ro musaari tana imar. Mi ni iso pio. Iso: “Kam mi kan. Mi sombe kan, nako inamut kat kembei bigil suruunu. Mi sombe isula kopom, inako ikam ma kopom iyoyou.”
To aŋkam ro ta ise aŋela namaana na ma aŋkan. Ila kwoŋ na inamut kat kembei ta bigil suruunu. Beso aŋteene ma isula na, itortooro kopoŋ ma iyoyou.
Mi sua imar tio ta kembei. Iso: “Kozo we Anutu kwoono mini, mi so kalŋaana pa mbulu tabe ipet pizin king mi zin tomtom boozomen. Zin kulin pareiŋan, kalŋan pareiŋan, mi timar pa karkari ta boozomen.”
